prompt:
Edit the attached paint_mask_guide.png, using design_reference.png as the approved material/detail reference and icon_x8.png only as the original colour reference (magenta is background). Produce ONE transparent PNG at 1536x2048, 3:4. Use case: precise-object-edit, game texture view atlas.

The guide is the authoritative geometry and layout. Three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 repeat exactly the same five grey orthographic renders: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty. These names are literal guide views; do not reinterpret them or replace narrow edge-on views with face-on shields. Preserve every object's exact position, size, outline, gaps and openings from the guide. Paint only existing grey pixels; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign. The large face-on shield is in column 2 row 2 and repeats in column 2 row 4. Narrow edge-on objects in all other occupied cells stay narrow.

Rows 1-2 PAINT: unlit base colour, upright tan wooden heater shield, plain wood rim, large blue heraldic lion matching reference. Wood grain, plank boundaries and blue lion follow the approved design scaled to visible faces. Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow reference where present. No invented metal or leather. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections, glow, halo, sparkles, aura, ground, outlines or text.

Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: exactly the same five silhouettes, filled with FLAT pure categorical colours only, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Pure red #FF0000 for metal (steel iron chain mail gold silver bronze copper brass); pure green #00FF00 for leather (straps padding hide suede) and fur; pure yellow #FFFF00 for matte non-metal solids (wood bone horn stone parchment paper wax); pure black #000000 for gemstone crystal glass pearl enamel or liquid through glass. This plain wooden shield including its blue-painted wooden lion area is matte wood, thus YELLOW in the mask, not blue or black. Each silhouette pixel gets exactly one material colour. Nothing outside silhouettes. Keep every gap/opening fully transparent, including thin slots in edge-on views. Column 3 row 2 and column 3 row 4 remain entirely empty and transparent. Preserve full canvas and layout exactly.

CORRECTION: The prior attempt had stray paint splashes and speckles beyond silhouettes and filled thin slots. Strictly use the original guide alpha silhouettes as exact boundaries. Absolutely no stray pixels, splatter, fringes, smudges or extra marks anywhere outside objects. Lower half must be perfectly flat solid #FFFF00 with clean edges, with the exact transparent slots of the guide preserved. Do not texture or shade the yellow mask. Upper half: retain original guide outlines and holes exactly. Use the original guide as edit target, not the previous attempt.
